scalar.quadrature: composite Simpson on a uniform even-interval grid
scalar.bounded_risk_estimator: all final scalar estimates clipped to [-2.5,0.5]; medians also retained without clipping
scalar.pilot: 30 fixed bump windows of full width 1.6, corrected weak OLS, clipped to [-2.5,0.5]
scalar.ratio_guard: denominator absolute magnitude >= 0.05 times clean generating-trajectory moment; diagnostics only, all medians retained

vdp.families: nested bumps: 30 width3; add30 width1.5 +60 width0.75; add120 width0.375 +240 width0.1875
vdp.reference_basis: H1-orthonormalized prescribed test-function span, common to both covariance models
vdp.covariance: Prop3 exact polynomial residual covariance at a fixed pilot model trajectory, iterated coefficient weights
vdp.scope: known-support WENDy-like component, not a modification or reproduction of complete author WENDy

theory.scope: closure of adjoint test-function range in OU covariance norm; sequential small-noise then dense-span limit
